text: I still OBJECT to close_above:high_52w_close: elder_5d [7, 10, 7, 7, 7] lost its colour three bars back and sits flat with no pattern, so there is no transition to buy (C4), and a new-high close buys in front of price, not at value (C10). Of the named triggers, a reclaim (raschke's reclaim:structure_shift_ref on H1) is nearer my method than the breakout, but I do not support either yet. What clears me: an elder dip-and-reclaim back to the top of the range, a transition bar, printing before the trigger is live. Until then I stand aside (C22).
